verses.zh: 心中的谋算在乎人；舌头的应对由于耶和华。
verses.kjv: The preparations of the heart in man, and the answer of the tongue, is from the LORD.
verses.en: People plan things in their hearts, but the right answer on the tongue comes from the LORD.

verses.zh: 人一切所行的，在自己眼中看为清洁；惟有耶和华衡量人心。
verses.kjv: All the ways of a man are clean in his own eyes; but the LORD weigheth the spirits.
verses.en: Everything a person does looks clean to them, but the LORD weighs what is really inside.

verses.zh: 你所做的，要交托耶和华，你所谋的，就必成立。
verses.kjv: Commit thy works unto the LORD, and thy thoughts shall be established.
verses.en: Hand over what you do to the LORD, and your plans will stand firm.

verses.zh: 耶和华所造的，各适其用；就是恶人也为祸患的日子所造。
verses.kjv: The LORD hath made all things for himself: yea, even the wicked for the day of evil.
verses.en: The LORD made everything for its own purpose, even bad people for the day of trouble.

verses.zh: 凡心里骄傲的，为耶和华所憎恶；虽然连手，他必不免受罚。
verses.kjv: Every one that is proud in heart is an abomination to the LORD: though hand join in hand, he shall not be unpunished.
verses.en: The LORD hates every proud heart. Be sure of this: such a person will not go unpunished.

verses.zh: 因怜悯诚实，罪孽得赎；敬畏耶和华的，远离恶事。
verses.kjv: By mercy and truth iniquity is purged: and by the fear of the LORD men depart from evil.
verses.en: Kindness and honesty make up for wrongdoing, and respecting the LORD keeps a person away from evil.

verses.zh: 人所行的，若蒙耶和华喜悦，耶和华也使他的仇敌与他和好。
verses.kjv: When a man’s ways please the LORD, he maketh even his enemies to be at peace with him.
verses.en: When the LORD is pleased with how a person lives, he makes even their enemies live at peace with them.

verses.zh: 多有财利，行事不义，不如少有财利，行事公义。
verses.kjv: Better is a little with righteousness than great revenues without right.
verses.en: Better to have a little and be fair than to have plenty by being unfair.

verses.zh: 人心筹算自己的道路；惟耶和华指引他的脚步。
verses.kjv: A man’s heart deviseth his way: but the LORD directeth his steps.
verses.en: A person plans their own road, but the LORD is the one who guides their steps.

verses.zh: 王的嘴中有神语，审判之时，他的口必不差错。
verses.kjv: A divine sentence is in the lips of the king: his mouth transgresseth not in judgment.
verses.en: A king's lips speak with authority; his mouth should not go wrong when he judges.

verses.zh: 公道的天平和秤都属耶和华；囊中一切法码都为他所定。
verses.kjv: A just weight and balance are the LORD’s: all the weights of the bag are his work.
verses.en: Honest scales and balances belong to the LORD; all the weights in the bag are his doing.

verses.zh: 作恶，为王所憎恶，因国位是靠公义坚立。
verses.kjv: It is an abomination to kings to commit wickedness: for the throne is established by righteousness.
verses.en: Kings should hate doing wrong, because a throne stands firm on doing right.

verses.zh: 公义的嘴为王所喜悦；说正直话的，为王所喜爱。
verses.kjv: Righteous lips are the delight of kings; and they love him that speaketh right.
verses.en: Kings are pleased with honest lips, and they love whoever speaks the truth.

verses.zh: 王的震怒如杀人的使者；但智慧人能止息王怒。
verses.kjv: The wrath of a king is as messengers of death: but a wise man will pacify it.
verses.en: A king's anger is like a messenger of death, but a wise person can calm it down.

verses.zh: 王的脸光使人有生命；王的恩典好像春云时雨。
verses.kjv: In the light of the king’s countenance is life; and his favour is as a cloud of the latter rain.
verses.en: When a king's face lights up, there is life; his kindness is like a rain cloud in spring.

verses.zh: 得智慧胜似得金子；选聪明强如选银子。
verses.kjv: How much better is it to get wisdom than gold! and to get understanding rather to be chosen than silver!
verses.en: Getting wisdom is far better than getting gold, and understanding is better to choose than silver.

verses.zh: 正直人的道是远离恶事；谨守己路的，是保全性命。
verses.kjv: The highway of the upright is to depart from evil: he that keepeth his way preserveth his soul.
verses.en: The highway of honest people leads away from evil; guarding your path guards your life.

verses.zh: 骄傲在败坏以先；狂心在跌倒之前。
verses.kjv: Pride goeth before destruction, and an haughty spirit before a fall.
verses.en: Pride comes before a crash, and a proud spirit before a fall.

verses.zh: 心里谦卑与穷乏人来往，强如将掳物与骄傲人同分。
verses.kjv: Better it is to be of an humble spirit with the lowly, than to divide the spoil with the proud.
verses.en: Better to be humble among poor people than to share stolen goods with proud ones.

verses.zh: 谨守训言的，必得好处；倚靠耶和华的，便为有福。
verses.kjv: He that handleth a matter wisely shall find good: and whoso trusteth in the LORD, happy is he.
verses.en: Whoever pays attention to teaching will do well, and whoever trusts the LORD is happy.

verses.zh: 心中有智慧，必称为通达人；嘴中的甜言，加增人的学问。
verses.kjv: The wise in heart shall be called prudent: and the sweetness of the lips increaseth learning.
verses.en: A wise heart is called sensible, and kind words help people learn more.

verses.zh: 人有智慧就有生命的泉源；愚昧人必被愚昧惩治。
verses.kjv: Understanding is a wellspring of life unto him that hath it: but the instruction of fools is folly.
verses.en: Understanding is a fountain of life to whoever has it, but foolishness is its own punishment.

verses.zh: 智慧人的心教训他的口，又使他的嘴增长学问。
verses.kjv: The heart of the wise teacheth his mouth, and addeth learning to his lips.
verses.en: A wise heart teaches the mouth what to say and helps the lips teach others.

verses.zh: 良言如同蜂房，使心觉甘甜，使骨得医治。
verses.kjv: Pleasant words are as an honeycomb, sweet to the soul, and health to the bones.
verses.en: Kind words are like a honeycomb: sweet to the heart and healing to the bones.

verses.zh: 有一条路，人以为正，至终成为死亡之路。
verses.kjv: There is a way that seemeth right unto a man, but the end thereof are the ways of death.
verses.en: There is a road that looks right to a person, but in the end it leads to death.

verses.zh: 劳力人的胃口使他劳力，因为他的口腹催逼他。
verses.kjv: He that laboureth laboureth for himself; for his mouth craveth it of him.
verses.en: A worker's hunger keeps him working, because his empty stomach keeps pushing him on.

verses.zh: 匪徒图谋奸恶，嘴上仿佛有烧焦的火。
verses.kjv: An ungodly man diggeth up evil: and in his lips there is as a burning fire.
verses.en: A worthless person digs up trouble, and his talk is like a burning fire.

verses.zh: 乖僻人播散纷争；传舌的，离间密友。
verses.kjv: A froward man soweth strife: and a whisperer separateth chief friends.
verses.en: A twisted person starts fights, and a gossip splits close friends apart.

verses.zh: 强暴人诱惑邻舍，领他走不善之道。
verses.kjv: A violent man enticeth his neighbour, and leadeth him into the way that is not good.
verses.en: A violent person tempts his neighbour and leads him down a road that is not good.

verses.zh: 眼目紧合的，图谋乖僻；嘴唇紧闭的，成就邪恶。
verses.kjv: He shutteth his eyes to devise froward things: moving his lips he bringeth evil to pass.
verses.en: Someone who narrows his eyes is planning something twisted; someone who tightens his lips is set on evil.

verses.zh: 白发是荣耀的冠冕，在公义的道上必能得着。
verses.kjv: The hoary head is a crown of glory, if it be found in the way of righteousness.
verses.en: Grey hair is a crown of glory, won by living the right way.

verses.zh: 不轻易发怒的，胜过勇士；治服己心的，强如取城。
verses.kjv: He that is slow to anger is better than the mighty; and he that ruleth his spirit than he that taketh a city.
verses.en: Being slow to anger is better than being a great soldier, and ruling your own heart is better than capturing a city.

verses.zh: 签放在怀里，定事由耶和华。
verses.kjv: The lot is cast into the lap; but the whole disposing thereof is of the LORD.
verses.en: The lot is thrown into the lap, but every decision comes from the LORD.
